tags: AN fittings, billet aluminium, EFI fuel system, fuel check valve, fuel pressure, FUEL SYSTEMS, Proflow
searchText: Proflow PFE613-08 EFI Fuel Check Valve | M10 x 1.0mm to -08AN | Billet Aluminium | Black SS Racetech Rods & Customs Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts > Motor Vehicle Fuel Systems > Fuel Pressure Regulators FUEL SYSTEMS AN fittings, billet aluminium, EFI fuel system, fuel check valve, fuel pressure, FUEL SYSTEMS, Proflow Proflow PFE613-08 EFI Fuel Check Valve — Eliminate Fuel Priming Delays Long crank times before startup are a sign of fuel pressure bleed-back — a common frustration on EFI builds where the fuel pump has to reprime the system every time you turn the key. tags: STEERING AND SHIFTERS
searchText: 3/4 Inch Steering Shaft Support Bearing, Suit Hot Rod, Ford, Chev, Holden MSRE-016 SS Racetech Rods & Customs Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories STEERING AND SHIFTERS STEERING AND SHIFTERS 3/4" Steering Shaft Support Bearing | MSRE-016 | Suits Hot Rod, Ford, Chev, Holden The MSRE-016 Steering Shaft Support Bearing is an essential component for any custom steering shaft setup using three or more universal joints. Designed to suit both 3/4" DD (double-D) and 3/4" round steering shafts , this support bearing — also known as a heim joint support — eliminates flex, vibration, and unwanted movement in long or multi-joint steering column assemblies, giving you precise, confidence-inspiring steering feel on the road or track. Product Specifications Part Number: MSRE-016 Shaft Compatibility: 3/4" DD (Double-D) and 3/4" Round steering shafts Includes: Support bearing/heim joint + 2 jam nuts for installation Application: Required when using 3 or more steering universal joints Barcode: 80014593 Vehicle Applications A popular choice for custom and performance steering builds across a wide range of vehicles, including: Hot rods and street rods Ford (classic and custom builds) Chevrolet / GM vehicles Holden (HQ, HJ, HX, HZ, Torana, and more) Any custom chassis or kit car requiring a supported multi-joint steering shaft Why You Need a Steering Shaft Support Bearing When a steering shaft runs through three or more universal joints, the intermediate shaft can whip, flex, or vibrate — particularly at speed or over rough surfaces. searchText: 370-04-BLK -4 Male to 1/8" NPT Female SS Racetech Rods & Customs Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories SPEEDFLOW FITTINGS '-4 AN, 1/8 inch, aluminium adapters, SPEEDFLOW FITTINGS Speedflow 370-04-BLK | -4 AN Male to 1/8" NPT Female Adapter | Black The Speedflow 370-04-BLK is a precision-machined -4 AN male to 1/8" NPT female adapter in black anodised finish , designed to connect -4 AN braided line systems to components with a 1/8" NPT (National Pipe Taper) female port. Offering greater flow capacity than the -3 AN SF370-03-BLK variant, the 370-04-BLK is the preferred choice for oil, fuel, turbo, and hydraulic applications where -4 AN line systems interface with 1/8" NPT ported components. Product Specifications Part Number: 370-04-BLK AN End: -4 AN male NPT End: 1/8" NPT female Finish: Black anodised Series: Speedflow 370 — AN Male to NPT Female Adapters Compatible With: Standard -4 AN male hose ends and 1/8" NPT male ports Barcode: 9342122011719 Applications The 370-04-BLK is a versatile adapter for connecting -4 AN braided lines to NPT-ported components across a wide range of performance builds, including: Turbo oil feed line connections to 1/8" NPT ported turbocharger centre sections Oil pressure gauge and sensor line connections Engine oil and coolant line connections to NPT-ported components Fuel pressure gauge and regulator connections Hydraulic line connections to 1/8" NPT ported valves and sensors Any application requiring a -4 AN to 1/8" NPT interface in a performance or race build 370-04 vs 370-03 — Choosing the Right Size The Speedflow 370 series AN to NPT adapters are available in both -3 AN (SF370-03-BLK) and -4 AN (370-04-BLK) configurations. The -4 AN variant provides a larger internal bore for increased fluid flow, making it the better choice for turbo oil feeds, fuel lines, and other high-flow applications. For lower-flow applications such as oil pressure sensors and gauge lines, the -3 AN SF370-03-BLK is typically sufficient. AN to NPT — Installation Note NPT fittings use a tapered thread that seals via thread interference. Always apply appropriate thread sealant or PTFE tape to the NPT threads during installation to ensure a leak-free seal. Very fine grade aluminum oxide abrasives cut fast and fine, leaving a smooth, finished surface. Suitable for use on a wide variety of materials and for many different tasks. The performance of Scotch-Brite™ General Purpose Hand Pad 7447 is comparable to steel wool grade 1. However, unlike steel wool, our Scotch-Brite™ pads won't shred during use, rust after use, or create fine metal splinters. The non-woven, open-web material resists loading and can be used dry, with water or solvents, and rinsed clean for reuse. This multipurpose 6 x 9" pad can be used by hand for precise control, with a hand pad block for uniform finishing, or on an in-line sander to cover large areas.This maroon hand pad uses aluminum oxide abrasive. Aluminum oxide is a popular choice among industrial professionals because of its cut-rate and long life. This mineral is a tough, durable abrasive that self-fractures to expose fresh cutting edges in use, whereas traditional abrasives, such as garnet, quickly wear down with use. Due to its high cut-rate, hardness, strength, and low heat retention, aluminum oxide mineral is widely used in grinding applications in addition to sanding and finishing use. Aluminum oxide is suitable on a wide variety of substrates in both woodworking and metalworking, including ferrous alloys. Our Scotch-Brite™ industrial abrasive products are a unique surface conditioning product with abrasives incorporated into non-woven nylon or other synthetic fibers. Combining abrasives into the fibers creates an abrasive system that delivers consistent results for the life of the product. The open-web material is load resistant and keeps the abrasive minerals cutting at high performance by limiting clogging of the fibers. tags: Aluminium Fuel Line Hard Tube, FUEL SYSTEMS
searchText: AF66-3316 - Aeroflow stainless steel fuel line 304 3/16" (4.76MM) X 7.5M SS Racetech Rods & Customs Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories FUEL SYSTEMS Aluminium Fuel Line Hard Tube, FUEL SYSTEMS Aeroflow Performance 304 stainless steel hard lines are aircraft-quality, thin wall tube which are double annealed for easier flaring and bending. This stainless-steel brake/fuel/oil line is ideal for routing lines along the chassis, frame rails or anywhere flexible line is not required. These stainless-steel hard lines are rated for up to 6000 psi and designed for use with tube line adapter fittings or when using a flaring tool with tube nut/tube sleeve combinations. The hard line is available in 25-foot rolls (7.6 meters) of 3/16" (4.76mm), 1/4" (6.35mm), 5/16" (7.95mm), 3/8" (9.52mm) or 1/2" (12.7mm) outside diameter tubing. Stainless steel tube manufactured to ASTM-A269 standards. NOTE: Stainless steel is more difficult to bend and flare, compared to typical steel line. We recommend that a professional-grade flaring tool be used with these lines. Stainless steel can also be difficult to seal when replacing an existing brake or fuel line. The previously installed line can create a wear pattern on the flare seat which will not allow the new stainless-steel flare to seal properly. When replacing an existing line we recommend a thorough inspection of the existing brake fitting, fuel fitting, junction block, wheel cylinder, brake caliper, etc. It's possible that the existing component may need to be replaced for a proper seal. The added benefit of weldability puts STEEL-IT at the top of all paints and coatings saving teams hours in repair time and gives the best protection for their expensive equipment. WHAT IS STEEL-IT? STEEL-IT coatings from Stainless Steel Coatings INC., has been in the business of perfecting their product since 1974. STEEL-IT is applied just like paint, however it contains custom-engineered 316L stainless steel flake for superior protection against corrosion, abrasion, and harsh chemicals. These microscopic 316L flakes tightly overlap to form a neat horizontal layered alignment, forming a metallic barrier film near the coating’s surface that is nearly impervious to corrosion and corrosive elements. As with all STEEL-IT Brand Coatings, STEEL-IT Polyurethane Aerosol products feature custom-engineered, 316L stainless steel flake and provides superior protection against corrosion, abrasion, salt, alkalis and other chemicals. The coating provides the added benefit of being weldable, UV-resistant, and USDA compliant for incidental food contact. STEEL-IT Polyurethane withstands high-pressure washdowns and detergents without chipping or flaking, a critical feature in so many applications across industries. searchText: STEEL-IT Polyurethane Aerosol - black SS Racetech Rods & Customs Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories CHEMICALS AND LUBE CHEMICALS AND LUBE STEEL-IT polyurethane coatings has become the choice of leading off-road builders and race teams. The coatings microscopic stainless steel flake provides superior performance in protecting suspension, chassis and other crucial components that require a durable shield against corrosion, high speed stone impacts, and all other harsh conditions of off-road driving. The added benefit of weldability puts STEEL-IT at the top of all paints and coatings saving teams hours in repair time and gives the best protection for their expensive equipment. WHAT IS STEEL-IT? STEEL-IT coatings from Stainless Steel Coatings INC., has been in the business of perfecting their product since 1974. STEEL-IT is applied just like paint, however it contains custom-engineered 316L stainless steel flake for superior protection against corrosion, abrasion, and harsh chemicals. These microscopic 316L flakes tightly overlap to form a neat horizontal layered alignment, forming a metallic barrier film near the coating’s surface that is nearly impervious to corrosion and corrosive elements. As with all STEEL-IT Brand Coatings, STEEL-IT Polyurethane Aerosol products feature custom-engineered, 316L stainless steel flake and provides superior protection against corrosion, abrasion, salt, alkalis and other chemicals. The coating provides the added benefit of being weldable, UV-resistant, and USDA compliant for incidental food contact. STEEL-IT Polyurethane withstands high-pressure washdowns and detergents without chipping or flaking, a critical feature in so many applications across industries. Single component coating that air dries Handy aerosol for easy-to-apply original jobs and touch-up work UV-resistant Weldable! – No need to grind off the coating when repairs or add-ons are required USDA compliant for incidental food contact Withstands high-pressure washdowns without chipping or flaking Temperature Rating: 200 °F The identical, high-quality coating as the Polyurethane Topcoat options available in quarts and gallons STEEL-IT Polyurethane Aerosol - black

title: KTKLS328 Nylon 28 Inch Long Black Four Layer Suspension Limiting Strap With 4130 Heat Treated Chromoly Ends - EACH
category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts > Motor Vehicle Suspension Parts
tags: SUSPENSION
searchText: KTKLS328 Nylon 28 Inch Long Black Four Layer Suspension Limiting Strap With 4130 Heat Treated Chromoly Ends - EACH SS Racetech Rods & Customs Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts > Motor Vehicle Suspension Parts SUSPENSION SUSPENSION 28" Limiting strap length is measured from center of bolt hole to center of bolt hole. The bolt holes are 9/16" in diameter. The strap's webbing material is rated between 14,000 to 15,000 pounds. The 4130 chromoly ends are rated to 15,000 pounds. Limiting straps are ideal for any off road application since they are vital in preventing damage to your suspension and drive train components. Without limiting straps, your shocks act as stops at maximum droop which can cause damage from your vehicle's unsprung weight. Limiting straps also prevent damage to your CV's by limiting the amount of maximum angle on your axles. The limit straps we carry are four-ply so only 1" of stretch is allowed for every 12" of strap. If you're going to use an adjustable clevis then you'll need to compensate for the extra length of the clevis. See clevis diagram. An adjustable clevis allows you to fine tune your suspension and it also allows you to shorten the distance as the strap stretches over time. You want to make sure that you double shear the bottom of the limiting strap mount for extra strength. Ideally, you would use a grade 9 bolt such as f911. The tab on the limiting strap and the tab that you weld to the chassis should always be lined up in the direction the limiting strap is going to pull. You never want to mount the tab "flat" to a surface because it will bend and eventually fail. Chromoly Chrome-Moly Chrome KTKLS328 Nylon 28 Inch Long Black Four Layer Suspension Limiting Strap With 4130 Heat Treated Chromoly Ends - EACH limiting straps

tags: '-12 AN, filters& brackets, SPEEDFLOW FITTINGS
searchText: 609-00-12-BLK -12 inline scavenge filter black SS Racetech Rods & Customs Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories SPEEDFLOW FITTINGS '-12 AN, filters& brackets, SPEEDFLOW FITTINGS Speedflow 609-00-12-BLK | -12 AN Inline Scavenge Filter | Black | 609 Series The Speedflow 609-00-12-BLK is a precision-machined -12 AN inline scavenge filter in black anodised finish , part of the Speedflow 609 series coarse screen scavenge filter range. Designed to be installed on dry sump scavenge lines, this filter provides critical protection for the dry sump pump by capturing debris in the event of a major engine failure — preventing catastrophic pump damage and keeping the oiling system intact when it matters most. Product Specifications Part Number: 609-00-12-BLK AN Size: -12 AN Type: Inline coarse screen scavenge filter Finish: Black anodised Weight: 100g Series: Speedflow 609 — Inline Scavenge Filters Compatible With: Standard -12 AN fittings and hose ends Barcode: 9342122017278 Applications The 609-00-12-BLK is an essential component for dry sump oiling system builds in high-performance and motorsport applications, including: Dry sump scavenge line protection on race engines and high-performance street builds V8 and high-displacement engine dry sump system fabrication Endurance racing and circuit car oiling system builds where engine failure debris protection is critical Any dry sump system where pump protection from catastrophic engine failure debris is required Why a Scavenge Filter? In a dry sump oiling system, the scavenge pump draws oil — and potentially debris — directly from the engine sump. In the event of a major engine failure such as a spun bearing, broken ring, or connecting rod failure, large debris particles can be rapidly drawn into the scavenge line. Without a scavenge filter, this debris can destroy the dry sump pump — turning a repairable engine failure into a far more costly total oiling system rebuild. The Speedflow 609 series coarse screen filter captures this debris inline, protecting the pump and allowing the system to be inspected and cleaned after a failure event. The -12 AN size provides ample flow capacity for high-volume scavenge lines on large-displacement performance engines. The black anodised finish is consistent with a quality race build aesthetic. Sold individually. Install on the scavenge line between the engine and dry sump pump. Compatible with standard -12 AN fittings and hose ends. It features a lithium soap base with premium quality base oils and 3% molybdenum disulphide (moly) for added extreme pressure protection. APPLICATION Molygrease EP 3% is used for general grease applications in automotive and industrial service areas. It is particularly suitable for use where the grease is likely to be exposed to the weather and/or squeezed out. In these applications, a thin film of molybdenum will provide some measure of protection until the component can be re-greased. Molygrease EP 3% is recommended for use on ball joints, king pins and universal joints. It can also be used on CV joints and as a general chassis grease. It is a highly effective industrial grease and may be used in plain bearings, slow speed industrial bearings (not anti-friction), vibrating and wet environments , general plant lubrication and in agricultural and construction equipment lubrication. The recommended Operating Temperature Range is from Minus 20 ° to +130°

In fact, you'll find ignitions from other companies that carry the 6AL name (and in some cases, the same part number). MSD raised the bar even higher with the revised Digital 6AL Ignition Control! The wiring of the Digital 6AL is routed out one end of the unit through a sealed and locking connector. This eases installation and keeps your wiring looking neat and clean. The rev limiter of the 6AL is located right on top of the housing for easy access to the two rotary dials to set the limit in 100 rpm increments. Inside the Digital 6AL you'll find a microprocessor that monitors and controls every firing and rev limit. The circuits are updated with efficient components that help the ignition produce more power while drawing less current! In fact, the Digital 6AL delivers over 530 volts to the coil with up to 135mJ of spark energy for every firing! Increased output combined with MSD's proven multiple spark series is a win-win situation! The Digital 6AL is supplied with the wiring harness and the components you'll need for installation. The 6AL is also supplied with vibration mounts. Both ignitions are compatible on 4, 6 or 8-cylinder engines with 12-volt, negative ground electrical systems. They'll accept trigger inputs from breaker points, amplifiers and magnetic pickups. OEM standardisation also means that your new relays can be directly installed in place of the originals with no fitment issues or surprises. The high quality replacement automotive relay from Narva are rated to a whopping 500,000 cycles, that's half a million times you can switch on your headlights, beep your horn or use your turn signals before the relay needs replacing. Narva sell replacement relays for a whole plethora of vehicles, as well as for aftermarket applications. In simple terms, a relay is an electrical switch which converts small electrical currents into larger high-output currents. Relays can reduce the need for high-amperage wiring and switches which are bulky and expensive and can pose a higher risk when installed inside a car. A relay does all the hard work by pulling power usually straight from the battery and using a secondary switched power source to trigger the circuit. For aftermarket applications, wiring like a pro is not as difficult as you might think. With a set of electrical tools , connectors, terminals and some electrical cable you can wire in your driving lights, winches, 12v sockets or air compressors like an absolute pro. searchText: 323-04 -4 90 degree bulkhead - steel SS Racetech Rods & Customs Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts SPEEDFLOW FITTINGS '-4 AN, 90 Degree hose ends, aluminium adapters, SPEEDFLOW FITTINGS Speedflow SF323-04 | -4 AN 90° Bulkhead Fitting | Steel The Speedflow SF323-04 is a precision-machined -4 AN 90-degree bulkhead fitting in steel , designed for routing -4 AN lines through a firewall, chassis panel, or bulkhead where a straight pass-through isn't possible or practical. The 90° angle allows the line to exit the panel parallel to its surface, making it the ideal solution for tight engine bays, transmission tunnels, and firewall installations where space is at a premium and a straight bulkhead would create an awkward hose bend. Product Specifications Part Number: SF323-04 AN Size: -4 AN Angle: 90 degrees Material: Steel Series: Speedflow 323 — Angled Bulkhead Fittings Compatible With: Standard -4 AN flare fittings and hose ends Barcode: 9342122031274 Applications The SF323-04 is the go-to choice when a straight bulkhead fitting won't provide clean hose routing, including: Firewall brake line pass-throughs where the line runs parallel to the firewall surface Fuel line routing through tight firewall or chassis panel locations Clutch hydraulic line bulkhead installations in confined spaces Oil and coolant line routing through bulkheads in race car and hot rod builds Any -4 AN application where a 90° exit angle eliminates stress on the hose end 90° vs Straight Bulkhead — When to Choose the Angle A straight bulkhead fitting works well when the line approaches the panel perpendicularly. However, when the line runs along the panel surface before passing through, a straight fitting forces a sharp bend immediately after the bulkhead — stressing the hose end and restricting flow. The SF323-04's 90° angle eliminates this problem entirely, allowing the line to exit parallel to the panel for a clean, low-stress routing path. This is particularly valuable in brake and fuel systems where hose integrity is safety-critical. For straight -4 AN bulkhead applications, see our SF320-04 listing. Sold individually. Compatible with standard -4 AN flare fittings and hose ends. searchText: 413-06-BLK -6 Female to 3/8" 90° Hose Tail SS Racetech Rods & Customs Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts SPEEDFLOW FITTINGS '-6 AN, 3/8 Inch, 90 Degree hose ends, hose tails, SPEEDFLOW FITTINGS Speedflow SF413-06-BLK | -6 AN Female to 3/8" Hose Tail | 90° | Black | 413 Series The Speedflow SF413-06-BLK is a precision-machined -6 AN female to 3/8" hose tail adapter with a 90° angle, in black anodised finish . Part of the Speedflow 413 series 90° hose tail range, this fitting connects -6 AN female ports to standard 3/8" (approx. 10mm) rubber or silicone push-on hose at a right angle — ideal for tight engine bay and chassis routing where a straight hose tail would force an awkward bend in the hose. Product Specifications Part Number: SF413-06-BLK AN End: -6 AN female Hose Tail: 3/8" (approx. 10mm) barb Angle: 90 degrees Finish: Black anodised Series: Speedflow 413 — 90° AN Female to Hose Tail Adapters Compatible With: Standard -6 AN male fittings and 3/8" ID rubber or silicone hose Applications The SF413-06-BLK is the go-to choice when a straight hose tail won’t provide clean routing, including: Fuel line connections where the hose runs parallel to the fitting face Coolant line connections in tight radiator and cooling system builds Oil feed and return line connections requiring a 90° hose exit Turbo oil return line connections in confined engine bays Catch can and breather line connections to AN-ported components Any -6 AN to 3/8" hose application where a 90° exit angle eliminates hose stress 413 Series (90°) vs 411 Series (Straight) — Choosing the Right Angle The Speedflow 411 series provides straight AN female to hose tail adapters, while the 413 series provides the same connection at a 90° angle . When the hose runs along the component surface before connecting, a straight hose tail forces a sharp bend immediately after the fitting — stressing the hose and restricting flow. The 413 series 90° angle eliminates this problem, allowing the hose to exit parallel to the component face for a clean, professional result. For straight -6 AN to 3/8" hose tail applications, see our 411-06-BLK listing. Sold individually. Secure hose tail connections with an appropriate hose clamp in pressurised applications. title: KTKLS326 Nylon 26 Inch Long Black Four Layer Suspension Limiting Strap With 4130 Heat Treated Chromoly Ends - EACH
tags: SUSPENSION
searchText: KTKLS326 Nylon 26 Inch Long Black Four Layer Suspension Limiting Strap With 4130 Heat Treated Chromoly Ends - EACH SS Racetech Rods & Customs Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories SUSPENSION SUSPENSION Nylon 26 Inch Long Black Four Layer Suspension Limiting Strap With 4130 Heat Treated Chromoly Ends 26" Limiting strap length is measured from center of bolt hole to center of bolt hole. The bolt holes are 9/16" in diameter. The strap's webbing material is rated between 14,000 to 15,000 pounds. The 4130 chromoly ends are rated to 15,000 pounds. Limiting straps are ideal for any off road application since they are vital in preventing damage to your suspension and drive train components. Without limiting straps, your shocks act as stops at maximum droop which can cause damage from your vehicle's unsprung weight. Limiting straps also prevent damage to your CV's by limiting the amount of maximum angle on your axles. The limit straps we carry are four-ply so only 1" of stretch is allowed for every 12" of strap. Hose is sold per meter. Speedflow 200 Series Teflon® Braided Hose is constructed from a PTFE (Teflon®) inner tube compatible with all brake & clutch fluids, oil & fuels. The outer stainless steel braided cover adds fire and heat resistance and gives the hose a high pressure rating. Sizes -6 and up are manufactured with an anti-static PTFE tube suitable for use as main fuel lines. 200 Series has been an industry standard since the mid 60's when it was first used as brake lines to reduce expansion and provide a much firmer "pedal" and more consistent braking. Since then this hose has evolved to be recommended in clutch, pressure lines, turbo lines and fuel systems. title: PFETBP4150B Proflow Fuel Injection Conversion Plate Kit, Series II, 4150 & 4500, Billet Aluminium, Black, Universal
tags: FUEL SYSTEMS, THROTTLE BODY'S & FUEL RAILS
searchText: PFETBP4150B Proflow Fuel Injection Conversion Plate Kit, Series II, 4150 & 4500, Billet Aluminium, Black, Universal SS Racetech Rods & Customs Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories FUEL SYSTEMS FUEL SYSTEMS, THROTTLE BODY'S & FUEL RAILS Proflow's series II fuel injection plate kit eliminates the need to replace or modify your non-EFI intake manifold, providing it has a 4150 or 4500 bolt pattern. This plate bolts onto your manifold like a regular carburettor but instead converts it to a fuel injected setup by allowing you to utilize up to eight 14mm O-Ring injectors. Long (60mm), standard (48mm) and short (34mm) injectors will securely mount between the fuel rails and plate as the steel shafts securely hold the rails, utilizing an improved double-shear bolted joint design. Long injectors mount directly to the plate and rails, while standard and short injectors can be used with the provided injector adapters. Suits most bosch style EV6, EV14 or any slim-line fuel injectors. Recommended to be used with a single plane manifold which will provide better fuel vaporisation and distribution between ports. This kit also comes with 2 gaskets, 2 sets of injector adapters and dowel pins which can be used to align a throttle body exactly with the injector plate, such as our quad throttle body (PFEQTB1000). Block-offs are also available to plug any unused injector ports. Black or silver anodised for long lasting performance. PFETBP4150B Proflow Fuel Injection Conversion Plate Kit, Series II, 4150 & 4500, Billet Aluminium, Black, Universal

title: KTKLS324 Nylon 24 Inch Long Black Four Layer Suspension Limiting Strap With 4130 Heat Treated Chromoly Ends
tags: SUSPENSION
searchText: KTKLS324 Nylon 24 Inch Long Black Four Layer Suspension Limiting Strap With 4130 Heat Treated Chromoly Ends SS Racetech Rods & Customs Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories SUSPENSION SUSPENSION Nylon 24 Inch Long Black Four Layer Suspension Limiting Strap With 4130 Heat Treated Chromoly Ends 24" Limiting strap length is measured from center of bolt hole to center of bolt hole. The bolt holes are 9/16" in diameter. The strap's webbing material is rated between 14,000 to 15,000 pounds. The 4130 chromoly ends are rated to 15,000 pounds. Limiting straps are ideal for any off road application since they are vital in preventing damage to your suspension and drive train components. Without limiting straps, your shocks act as stops at maximum droop which can cause damage from your vehicle's unsprung weight. Limiting straps also prevent damage to your CV's by limiting the amount of maximum angle on your axles. The limit straps we carry are four-ply so only 1" of stretch is allowed for every 12" of strap. Chromoly Chrome-Moly Chrome Moly If you're going to use an adjustable clevis then you'll need to compensate for the extra length of the clevis. See clevis diagram. An adjustable clevis allows you to fine tune your suspension and it also allows you to shorten the distance as the strap stretches over time. You want to make sure that you double shear the bottom of the limiting strap mount for extra strength. Ideally, you would use a grade 9 bolt such as f911. The tab on the limiting strap and the tab that you weld to the chassis should always be lined up in the direction the limiting strap is going to pull. You never want to mount the tab "flat" to a surface because it will bend and eventually fail. searchText: KTKHMA10058TR 17-4 Stainless Steel Misalignment Spacer For 1" Heim Or Uniball For 5/8" Bolt 3-1/16" Stack Height (PAIR) SS Racetech Rods & Customs Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts ROD ENDS AND UNIBALLS misalignment spacer, ROD ENDS AND UNIBALLS 17-4 Stainless Steel Misalignment Spacer For 1" Heim Or Uniball For 5/8" Bolt 3-1/16" Stack Height High misalignment spacers are designed for suspension joints, steering tie rod ends and anything else that uses the pivot of a spherical bearing such as heim joints, rod ends and uniballs. They have two functions. They reduce the hole size to accommodate a smaller bolt and increase the max angle of a spherical bearing. How much the angle is increased is determined by the bolt size and the amount of material removed. When more material is removed, the strength of the spacer is decreased. The same happens when using a larger bolt. To compensate for this we only use heat treated 17-4 stainless steel for our spacers. This also prevents corrosion when used in everyday applications. title: 421-06-08-BLK 3/8" NPT to 1/2" hose tail
tags: '-6 AN, -8 AN, 1/2 Inch, 3/8 Inch, hose tails, SPEEDFLOW FITTINGS
searchText: 421-06-08-BLK 3/8" NPT to 1/2" hose tail SS Racetech Rods & Customs Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories SPEEDFLOW FITTINGS '-6 AN, -8 AN, 1/2 Inch, 3/8 Inch, hose tails, SPEEDFLOW FITTINGS Speedflow SF421-06-08-BLK | 3/8" NPT to 1/2" Hose Tail | Black | 421 Series The Speedflow SF421-06-08-BLK is a precision-machined 3/8" NPT male to 1/2" hose tail adapter in black anodised finish , part of the Speedflow 421 series NPT hose tail range. Designed for high-flow applications, this adapter connects 3/8" NPT ported components to standard 1/2" (approx. 13mm) rubber or silicone push-on hose — making it an essential fitting for coolant, oil, fuel, and power steering line builds in performance and motorsport vehicles. Product Specifications Part Number: SF421-06-08-BLK NPT End: 3/8" NPT male Hose Tail: 1/2" (approx. 13mm) barb Finish: Black anodised Series: Speedflow 421 — NPT Hose Tails (Aluminium Barb Fittings) Compatible With: 3/8" NPT female ports and 1/2" ID rubber or silicone hose Applications The SF421-06-08-BLK is a high-flow hose tail adapter suited to a wide range of performance plumbing applications, including: Engine coolant line connections from 3/8" NPT ported thermostat housings, blocks, and heads Oil feed and return line connections from 3/8" NPT ported oil coolers and sandwich plates Power steering reservoir and pump line connections Fuel line connections from 3/8" NPT ported fuel regulators and filters Heater hose connections to 3/8" NPT ported fittings Any high-flow application requiring a 3/8" NPT male to 1/2" push-on hose interface 421 Series — NPT Hose Tails The Speedflow 421 series covers a comprehensive range of NPT male to hose tail sizes in black anodised aluminium, from small-bore 1/16" NPT gauge line adapters through to large-bore 3/8" NPT high-flow fittings like the SF421-06-08-BLK. The 3/8" NPT to 1/2" hose tail combination is one of the most commonly used in coolant and oil system plumbing, providing ample flow capacity for engine cooling and lubrication applications. The barbed hose tail grips securely to push-on hose for a reliable connection. NPT Installation Note NPT fittings use a tapered thread that seals via thread interference. Always apply appropriate thread sealant or PTFE tape to the NPT male threads during installation. Do not overtighten — NPT threads can crack cast components if over-torqued. Secure the hose tail with an appropriate hose clamp for pressurised coolant and oil applications. Sold individually. Compatible with 3/8" NPT female ports and 1/2" ID rubber or silicone hose. Connecting 3/8" NPT ported components directly to 3/8" (approx. 10mm) rubber or silicone push-on hose, this adapter is a staple fitting for coolant, oil, fuel, and power steering line builds in performance and motorsport vehicles where port and hose sizes are matched. Product Specifications Part Number: SF421-06-06-BLK NPT End: 3/8" NPT male Hose Tail: 3/8" (approx. 10mm) barb Finish: Black anodised Series: Speedflow 421 — NPT Hose Tails (Aluminium Barb Fittings) Compatible With: 3/8" NPT female ports and 3/8" ID rubber or silicone hose Applications The SF421-06-06-BLK is a versatile high-flow hose tail adapter suited to a wide range of performance plumbing applications, including: Engine coolant line connections from 3/8" NPT ported thermostat housings, blocks, and heads Oil feed and return line connections from 3/8" NPT ported oil coolers and sandwich plates Power steering reservoir and pump line connections Fuel line connections from 3/8" NPT ported fuel regulators and filters Heater hose and bypass line connections to 3/8" NPT ported fittings Any application requiring a matched 3/8" NPT male to 3/8" push-on hose interface SF421-06-06 vs SF421-06-08 — Matched vs Stepped Hose Tail Both fittings share the same 3/8" NPT male port but differ in hose tail size. The SF421-06-06-BLK features a matched 3/8" hose tail for direct connection to 3/8" ID hose, while the SF421-06-08-BLK steps up to a 1/2" hose tail for higher-flow applications. Choose the SF421-06-06-BLK when your hose ID matches the port size, and the SF421-06-08-BLK when you need to step up to larger hose for increased flow capacity. NPT Installation Note NPT fittings use a tapered thread that seals via thread interference. Always apply appropriate thread sealant or PTFE tape to the NPT male threads during installation. Do not overtighten — NPT threads can crack cast components if over-torqued. Secure the hose tail with an appropriate hose clamp for pressurised coolant and oil applications. Sold individually. Compatible with 3/8" NPT female ports and 3/8" ID rubber or silicone hose. This stepped adapter connects 1/8" NPT ported components to the larger 3/8" (approx. 10mm) rubber or silicone push-on hose — ideal for oil pressure, coolant, and breather line applications where a step-up in hose diameter is required for improved flow or routing flexibility. The 1/8" NPT port is common across oil pressure senders, turbo centre sections, and small coolant ports. While a matched 1/8" hose tail is sufficient for low-flow gauge and sensor lines, stepping up to a 3/8" hose tail is beneficial when routing to a larger hose section, reducing flow restriction in oil or coolant feeds, or when 3/8" hose is the standard used throughout the rest of the build for consistency. The SF421-02-06-BLK provides this step-up in a single compact fitting. NPT Installation Note NPT fittings use a tapered thread that seals via thread interference. Always apply appropriate thread sealant or PTFE tape to the NPT male threads during installation. Do not overtighten. Secure the hose tail with an appropriate hose clamp for pressurised applications. Sold individually. Compatible with 1/8" NPT female ports and 3/8" ID rubber or silicone hose. It contains high quality base oils and a superior anti wear package of FULL ZINC (exceeding 1200+ ppm levels) for ultimate engine, gearbox & clutch protection. It meets the requirements of API SG /CF and JASO MA. APPLICATION MC-4ST MINERAL 20W-50 is designed for use in four stroke road & sports bikes, dirt & enduro bikes, ATV's/Quad bikes and scooters. It is designed for use in high performance, 4 stroke motorcycle engines in applications where a premium mineral oil is specified by the manufacturer. It is also equally suitable for use in transmissions with wet clutch systems where engine & gearbox oils are combined. It has optimum clutch slip prevention in these systems being compliant with JASO MA as is suitable for use where JASO MA1 and JASO MA2 is specified. MC-4ST MINERAL 20W-50 can be used where SAE 20W-50 or SAE 30 grade oils are specified by the manufacturer such as in Buell , Victory & Harley Davidson and more. MC-4ST MINERAL 20W-50 is also suitable for use in other four stroke engines such as stationary engines & generators or other vehicles that require this grade and specification of engine oil and can be used with petrol, racing & other conventional fuels.

title: KTKLS320 Nylon 20 Inch Long Black Four Layer Suspension Limiting Strap With 4130 Heat Treated Chromoly Ends - EACH
category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts > Motor Vehicle Suspension Parts
tags: SUSPENSION
searchText: KTKLS320 Nylon 20 Inch Long Black Four Layer Suspension Limiting Strap With 4130 Heat Treated Chromoly Ends - EACH SS Racetech Rods & Customs Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts > Motor Vehicle Suspension Parts SUSPENSION SUSPENSION Nylon 20 Inch Long Black Four Layer Suspension Limiting Strap With 4130 Heat Treated Chromoly End 20" Limiting strap length is measured from center of bolt hole to center of bolt hole. The bolt holes are 9/16" in diameter. The strap's webbing material is rated between 14,000 to 15,000 pounds. The 4130 chromoly ends are rated to 15,000 pounds. Limiting straps are ideal for any off road application since they are vital in preventing damage to your suspension and drive train components. Without limiting straps, your shocks act as stops at maximum droop which can cause damage from your vehicle's unsprung weight. Limiting straps also prevent damage to your CV's by limiting the amount of maximum angle on your axles. The limit straps we carry are four-ply so only 1" of stretch is allowed for every 12" of strap. Chromoly Chrome-Moly Chrome Moly If you're going to use an adjustable clevis then you'll need to compensate for the extra length of the clevis. See clevis diagram. An adjustable clevis allows you to fine tune your suspension and it also allows you to shorten the distance as the strap stretches over time. You want to make sure that you double shear the bottom of the limiting strap mount for extra strength. Ideally, you would use a grade 9 bolt such as f911. The tab on the limiting strap and the tab that you weld to the chassis should always be lined up in the direction the limiting strap is going to pull. You never want to mount the tab "flat" to a surface because it will bend and eventually fail. searchText: KTKHMA7858 17-4 Stainless Steel Misalignment Spacer For 7/8" Heim Or Uniball For 5/8" Bolt 2-1/8" Stack Height (PAIR) SS Racetech Rods & Customs Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories ROD ENDS AND UNIBALLS Misalignment Spacers, ROD ENDS AND UNIBALLS High misalignment spacers are designed for suspension joints, steering tie rod ends and anything else that uses the pivot of a spherical bearing such as heim joints, rod ends and uniballs. They have two functions. They reduce the hole size to accommodate a smaller bolt and increase the max angle of a spherical bearing. How much the angle is increased is determined by the bolt size and the amount of material removed. When more material is removed, the strength of the spacer is decreased. The same happens when using a larger bolt. To compensate for this we only use heat treated 17-4 stainless steel for our spacers. This also prevents corrosion when used in everyday applications. We offer a wide variety of high misalignment spacers for almost every possible application. Important Notes: Not all spacers will fit every uniball or heim joint. The stack height or width in the title of the page is a nominal dimension. See below for actual decimal dimension. Specifications: Material: 17-4 Heat treated stainless steel (A) Shoulder Height: 0.625" (B) Head Diameter: 1.030" (C) Half The Stack Height: 1.060" Nominal Stack Height: 2-1/8" Actual Stack Height: 2.125" (D) Bolt Size: 5/8" (E) Heim Or Uniball Size: 7/8" (F) Depth: 0.437" Stack height or stack width, depending on which way you look at it, is an important dimension for you to know for the length of the bolt you'll need plus the gap that you'll need in order to put the rod end or uniball on your vehicle. We sell the spacers individually because occasionally customers will use two different heights of spacers on one rod end or uniball to achieve the stack height required for their vehicle. title: KTKCLV123 Adjustable Chromoly Limiting Strap Clevis 1/2" Diameter Shank Holds Up To 3 Suspension Straps
category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts > Motor Vehicle Suspension Parts
tags: SUSPENSION
searchText: KTKCLV123 Adjustable Chromoly Limiting Strap Clevis 1/2" Diameter Shank Holds Up To 3 Suspension Straps SS Racetech Rods & Customs Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts > Motor Vehicle Suspension Parts SUSPENSION SUSPENSION Adjustable Limiting Strap Clevis 1/2" Diameter Shank Holds Up To 3 Suspension Limiting Straps Limiting strap length is measured from center of bolt hole to center of bolt hole. The bolt holes are 9/16" in diameter. Limiting straps are ideal for any off road application since they are vital in preventing damage to your suspension and drive train components. Without limiting straps, your shocks act as stops at maximum droop which can cause damage from your vehicle's unsprung weight. Limiting straps also prevent damage to your CV's by limiting the amount of maximum angle on your axles. The limit straps we carry are four-ply so only 1" of stretch is allowed for every 12" of strap. Chromoly Chrome-Moly Chrome Moly If you're going to use an adjustable clevis then you'll need to compensate for the extra length of the clevis. See clevis diagram. An adjustable clevis allows you to fine tune your suspension and it also allows you to shorten the distance as the strap stretches over time. You want to make sure that you double shear the bottom of the limiting strap mount for extra strength. Ideally, you would use a grade 9 bolt such as f911. The tab on the limiting strap and the tab that you weld to the chassis should always be lined up in the direction the limiting strap is going to pull. You never want to mount the tab "flat" to a surface because it will bend and eventually fail. searchText: PENRITE GREEN OEM COOLANT PREMIX - 5LTR SS Racetech Rods & Customs Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Vehicle Maintenance, Care & Decor > Vehicle Fluids > Vehicle Motor Oil CHEMICALS AND LUBE CHEMICALS AND LUBE Green OEM Coolant Premix is a GENUINE GLYSANTIN ® G48®, Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) , fully licensed and warranty approved , type "A" ethylene glycol , anti-freeze anti-boil coolant as used in initial manufacturer factory fills. It uses a technically advanced HYBRID ( HOAT - Hybrid Organic Acid Technology) based inhibitor system that is Phosphate , Amine and Nitrite free. The extended long life inhibitor formulation prevents rust, corrosion, cavitation and degradation of the cooling system for 8 years or 500,000km. It is available in both concentrate and premix formulations. Green OEM Coolant Premix is mixed at a 50% concentration level as per initial manufacturer requirements. PLEASE NOTE: Green OEM Coolant Concentrate replaces 7 Year Green Coolant concentrate, 4 Year Long Drain Anti Freeze Anti Boil Coolant and Heavy Duty 50/50 premix APPLICATION Green OEM Coolant Premix is suitable for the cooling systems of petrol, LPG , light and heavy duty diesel and industrial engines where Hybrid (HOAT) type anti-freeze / anti-boil and anti-corrosion properties are required. Green OEM Coolant Premix is suitable for passenger cars, 4WD's, motorcycles, light & heavy duty commercial vehicles, construction and agricultural equipment. It is especially suited to vehicles of European origin such as Audi / VW (G11), BMW, Mercedes, Porsche (Pre-1995), Volvo, Opel & Saab, but it may be used in all types of vehicles. Green OEM Coolant Premix provides long-term protection against rust and corrosion for all materials used in the engine and in the cooling system construction. It protects cast iron , aluminium, copper and solder alloys as well as the hoses, seals and plastics used for the cooling system construction. It is effective in all cast iron aluminium engines that are under load or used in extreme hot and cold climates . Green OEM Coolant Premix may be used in all types of vehicles that use green, blue or yellow coloured initial fill coolants and it is also suitable for use in out of warranty service to maintain OEM performance. It is also ideal for motorcycles. Green OEM Coolant Premix is a 50% concentration formulation and is ready to use directly from the container . It is pre-mixed with Penrite De-Mineralised Water and can be poured directly into the cooling system. No further dilution is required. It can be used as a complete service refill , top up or is safe to mix with compatible type A coolant . Penrite recommend that a 50% concentration level should be maintained for maximum, performance and longevity of the coolant and protection of the cooling system.

Hardened steel backs on all rod bearings to improve the support of the bearing lining and assist with bearing retention in the housing. Increased crush for improved bearing retention. Connecting 1/8" NPT ported components to standard 1/4" (approx. 6mm) rubber or silicone push-on hose, this adapter sits between the 3/16" and 5/16" variants in the 1/8" NPT hose tail family — suited to oil pressure gauge lines, vacuum and boost reference lines, and small-bore sensor connections in performance and motorsport builds. Always apply appropriate thread sealant or PTFE tape to the NPT male threads during installation. Do not overtighten. For low-pressure gauge and vacuum lines, a hose clamp may not be required, but is recommended for any pressurised application. Sold individually. searchText: 370-03-BLK -3 male to 1/8" NPT female SS Racetech Rods & Customs Vehicles & Parts SPEEDFLOW FITTINGS '-3 AN, 1/8 inch, aluminium adapters, SPEEDFLOW FITTINGS Speedflow SF370-03-BLK | -3 AN Male to 1/8" NPT Female Adapter | Black The Speedflow SF370-03-BLK is a precision-machined -3 AN male to 1/8" NPT female adapter in black anodised finish , designed to connect -3 AN braided line systems to components with a 1/8" NPT (National Pipe Taper) female port. The 1/8" NPT thread is one of the most widely used port standards across aftermarket gauges, sensors, oil pressure fittings, and hydraulic components — making this a highly versatile adapter for performance and motorsport builds. Product Specifications Part Number: SF370-03-BLK AN End: -3 AN male NPT End: 1/8" NPT female Finish: Black anodised Series: Speedflow 370 — AN Male to NPT Female Adapters Compatible With: Standard -3 AN male hose ends and 1/8" NPT male ports Barcode: 9342122011702 Applications The SF370-03-BLK is a go-to adapter for connecting AN braided lines to NPT-ported components across a wide range of performance builds, including: Oil pressure gauge and sensor line connections Turbo oil feed and return line adaptations Engine oil and coolant line connections to NPT-ported components Fuel pressure gauge and regulator connections Brake and hydraulic line connections to 1/8" NPT ported valves and sensors Any application requiring a -3 AN to 1/8" NPT interface in a performance build AN to NPT — Bridging Two Common Standards AN (Army-Navy) and NPT (National Pipe Taper) are the two dominant plumbing standards in performance and motorsport builds. AN fittings use a 37° flare seat for a leak-free metal-to-metal seal, while NPT fittings use a tapered thread that seals via thread interference — typically with thread sealant or PTFE tape. The SF370-03-BLK bridges these two standards cleanly, allowing -3 AN braided lines to connect directly to the vast range of 1/8" NPT ported aftermarket components. The black anodised finish adds a premium aesthetic suited to show-quality and race builds alike. Note: Apply appropriate thread sealant or PTFE tape to the NPT threads during installation. While similar in thread size to the inverted flare SF340-03, the dual flare variant is specifically suited to components using a double flare seat geometry — making it critical to select the correct fitting for your specific application. Product Specifications Part Number: SF347-03 AN End: -3 AN male Dual Flare End: 3/8"-24 male dual flare Series: Speedflow 347 — AN to Dual Flare Adapters Compatible With: Standard -3 AN hose ends and 3/8"-24 dual flare ports Barcode: 9342122002694 Applications The SF347-03 is suited to a range of performance and custom brake system builds, including: Connecting -3 AN braided brake lines to master cylinders and calipers with 3/8"-24 dual flare ports Brake proportioning and bias valve connections on dual flare brake systems Hot rod, muscle car, and classic vehicle brake line upgrades from steel tube to AN braided Custom brake line fabrication requiring a 3/8"-24 dual flare interface Any application bridging -3 AN braided lines to 3/8"-24 double flare brake components Dual Flare vs Inverted Flare — Know the Difference The dual flare (also known as a double flare) and the inverted flare share the same thread size in many cases but use different seat geometries and are not interchangeable . A dual flare fitting seats against a folded-over tube end, while an inverted flare seats against a cone-shaped flare. Always verify which flare type your component uses before ordering. Featuring a spring-loaded high-flow poppet valve design, the SF610-06-BLK positively stops fluid from returning through the line — making it an essential component for dry sump oil systems, fuel systems, turbo oil drain lines, and any performance plumbing application where backflow prevention is critical. Product Specifications Part Number: SF610-06-BLK AN Size: -6 AN Type: One-way poppet check valve (spring-loaded) Finish: Black anodised Poppet Cracking Pressure: 2–3 psi (standard for -3 to -8 AN sizes) Series: Speedflow 610 — One-Way Poppet Check Valves Compatible With: Standard -6 AN fittings and hose ends Applications The SF610-06-BLK is an essential backflow prevention component for a wide range of high-performance plumbing applications, including: Dry sump oil system scavenge and pressure lines requiring positive backflow prevention Turbo oil drain line protection to prevent oil pooling in the turbocharger when the engine is off Fuel system check valve applications to maintain fuel pressure and prevent drain-back Remote oil filter and oil cooler line installations requiring one-way flow control Any performance plumbing application where fluid backflow must be positively prevented High-Flow Poppet Valve Design Unlike ball-type check valves, the Speedflow 610 series uses a spring-loaded poppet valve that opens fully under flow and seals positively when flow stops — providing a more reliable, higher-flow seal than ball-type alternatives. title: 390-04 -4 female tube nut
tags: '-4 AN, caps & washers, SPEEDFLOW FITTINGS
searchText: 390-04 -4 female tube nut SS Racetech Rods & Customs Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories SPEEDFLOW FITTINGS '-4 AN, caps & washers, SPEEDFLOW FITTINGS Speedflow SF390-04 | -4 AN Female Tube Nut | 37° Flare The Speedflow SF390-04 is a precision-machined -4 AN female tube nut designed for use with 37° flared tubing in performance brake, fuel, oil, and hydraulic line assemblies. The tube nut threads onto a male AN fitting and clamps the flared tube end securely against the fitting seat, creating a leak-free metal-to-metal seal — the same proven connection method used throughout AN plumbing systems in motorsport and performance builds worldwide. Product Specifications Part Number: SF390-04 AN Size: -4 AN female Flare Requirement: 37° flare on tube end Type: Female tube nut Series: Speedflow 390 — AN Female Tube Nuts Compatible With: Standard -4 AN male fittings and 37° flared tubing Barcode: 9342122021114 Applications The SF390-04 is an essential component for hard line and tube-based AN plumbing builds, including: Brake hard line connections to AN fittings and components Fuel hard line connections in custom fuel system builds Oil and hydraulic hard line assemblies in engine and chassis builds Replacing damaged or corroded OEM tube nuts with AN-compatible hardware Any application requiring a -4 AN female tube nut for 37° flared tubing 37° Flare — The AN Standard The 37° flare is the defining characteristic of the AN (Army-Navy) plumbing standard and is distinct from the 45° flare used in some OEM and SAE applications. The tube nut works by threading onto the male AN fitting and drawing the 37° flared tube end tightly against the fitting’s matching cone seat, creating a reliable metal-to-metal seal without the need for sealants or gaskets. Always ensure your tubing is flared to exactly 37° before assembly — a 45° flare will not seal correctly in an AN fitting. Sold individually. Requires 37° flare on the tube end. Compatible with standard -4 AN male fittings. Speedflow SF390-04 | -4 AN Female Tube Nut 37° Flare | SS Racetech Speedflow SF390-04: -4 AN female tube nut for 37° flared tubing. title: MSD-32829 MSD Spark Plug Wires, Copper, Silicone, Multi-Angle, 8.5mm Dia., Red, GM LS Engines, Set
category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts > Motor Vehicle Power & Electrical Systems
tags: ELECTRICAL, ls engine, MSD Spark plug leads
searchText: MSD-32829 MSD Spark Plug Wires, Copper, Silicone, Multi-Angle, 8.5mm Dia., Red, GM LS Engines, Set SS Racetech Rods & Customs Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts > Motor Vehicle Power & Electrical Systems ELECTRICAL ELECTRICAL, ls engine, MSD Spark plug leads Engineered from the inside out, the 8.5 offers everything you have ever wanted in a wire; incredibly low resistance without electronic interference! In a single 12 inch length of Super Conductor Wire, there are only 40 - 50 ohms of resistance! That is the lowest resistance of any helically wound wire. To accomplish this, we use a copper alloy conductor due to its great voltage carrying capabilities. The low resistance results in less loss in spark energy so more reaches the spark plug. The conductor is wound extremely tight around a special centre core. So tight in fact, that there are over 40 feet of conductor wrapped into a single foot of plug wire. This winding procedure, combined with a ferromagnetic impregnated centre core, produces an extremely effective Electro Magnetic Interference (EMI) "choke". This choke, or suppression capability, keeps the EMI inside the wire where it cannot interfere with other electronics on your vehicle. The outer sleeve that surrounds the conductor assembly is just as impressive. A proprietary blend of silicone and synthetic material produces a sleeve that is highly resistant to high heat as well as abrasion and tears. The MSD's 8.5mm spark plug terminals feature Dual Crimp terminals. As the name implies, the terminals feature two crimps; one for the sleeve of the wire and another separate crimp to grasp the conductor. searchText: 383-03 -3 male 1/8" NPT male 90 degree SS Racetech Rods & Customs Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts SPEEDFLOW FITTINGS '-3 AN, 1/8 inch, 90 Degree hose ends, aluminium adapters, SPEEDFLOW FITTINGS Speedflow SF383-03 | -3 AN Male to 1/8" NPT Male 90° Adapter | 380 Series The Speedflow SF383-03 is a precision-machined -3 AN male to 1/8" NPT male 90-degree adapter , part of the Speedflow 380 series AN flare to NPT steel adapter range. The 90° angle allows the -3 AN hose end to exit perpendicular to the NPT port, making it the ideal solution for tight engine bay, caliper, and sensor installations where a straight adapter would force an awkward hose bend. Product Specifications Part Number: SF383-03 AN End: -3 AN male NPT End: 1/8" NPT male Angle: 90 degrees Weight: 22g Series: Speedflow 380 — AN Flare to NPT Steel Adapters Compatible With: Standard -3 AN fittings and 1/8" NPT female ports Barcode: 9342122003042 Applications The SF383-03 is the go-to choice when a straight AN to NPT adapter won’t provide clean hose routing, including: Brake caliper and master cylinder connections where the line runs parallel to the port face Clutch master and slave cylinder hydraulic line connections in confined spaces Oil pressure gauge and sensor connections on engine blocks and heads Turbo oil feed line connections where a 90° exit eliminates hose stress Fuel pressure gauge and regulator connections requiring a right-angle exit Any -3 AN to 1/8" NPT application where a 90° angle improves routing and reduces hose end stress 90° vs Straight — When to Choose the Angle A straight AN to NPT adapter works well when the hose approaches the port perpendicularly. However, when the hose runs along the component surface before connecting, a straight adapter forces a sharp bend immediately after the fitting — stressing the hose end and restricting flow. The SF383-03’s 90° angle eliminates this problem, allowing the -3 AN line to exit parallel to the component face for a clean, low-stress routing path. For straight -3 AN to 1/8" NPT applications, see our SF382-03 listing. AN to NPT — Installation Note NPT fittings use a tapered thread that seals via thread interference. Always apply appropriate thread sealant or PTFE tape to the NPT male threads during installation. Do not overtighten — NPT threads can crack cast components if over-torqued. Sold individually. Weight: 22g. Compatible with standard -3 AN fittings and 1/8" NPT female ports. In high-performance applications, heat is the enemy of reliability. Speedflow firesleeve provides professional-grade thermal protection that keeps your fuel lines, oil lines, and electrical wiring safe from radiant heat, exhaust manifolds, turbochargers, and other extreme heat sources. The expandable braided construction makes installation straightforward while the silicone coating ensures long-term durability against oil, fuel, and environmental exposure. Whether you're building a race car, street performance vehicle, or industrial application, Speedflow firesleeve delivers the protection you need. Perfect for: Large fuel lines near exhaust, oil cooler lines, brake lines, electrical wiring, turbo applications, and any hose or cable requiring heat protection Specifications: -16 AN size, 260°C continuous / 1300°C max exposure, braided fibreglass with black silicone coating, expandable, sold per meter Speedflow -16 AN Firesleeve Black Heat Sleeve Per Meter - SFFS599-16 Speedflow -16 AN firesleeve per meter. searchText: KTKHMA10034RN 17-4 Stainless Steel Misalignment Spacer For 1" Heim Or Uniball For 3/4" Bolt 2-3/4" Stack Height (PAIR) SS Racetech Rods & Customs Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts ROD ENDS AND UNIBALLS Misalignment Spacers, ROD ENDS AND UNIBALLS KTK-HMA10034RN 17-4 Stainless Steel Misalignment Spacer For 3/4" Heim Or Uniball For 1/2" Bolt 1-13/16" Stack Ht High misalignment spacers are designed for suspension joints, steering tie rod ends and anything else that uses the pivot of a spherical bearing such as heim joints, rod ends and uniballs. They have two functions. They reduce the hole size to accommodate a smaller bolt and increase the max angle of a spherical bearing. How much the angle is increased is determined by the bolt size and the amount of material removed. When more material is removed, the strength of the spacer is decreased. The same happens when using a larger bolt. To compensate for this we only use heat treated 17-4 stainless steel for our spacers. This also prevents corrosion when used in everyday applications. We offer a wide variety of high misalignment spacers for almost every possible application. Important Notes: Not all spacers will fit every uniball or heim joint. See diagram below regarding uniballs. The stack height or width in the title of the page is a nominal dimension. See below for actual decimal dimension. Specifications: Material: 17-4 Heat treated stainless steel (A) Shoulder Height: 0.475" (B) Head Diameter: 1.000" (C) Half The Stack Height: 0.910" Nominal Stack Height: 1-13/16" Actual Stack Height: 1.820" (D) Bolt Size: 1/2" (E) Heim Or Uniball Size: 3/4" (F) Depth: 0.437" Stack height or stack width, depending on which way you look at it, is an important dimension for you to know for the length of the bolt you'll need plus the gap that you'll need in order to put the rod end or uniball on your vehicle. We sell the spacers individually because occasionally customers will use two different heights of spacers on one rod end or uniball to achieve the stack height required for their vehicle. The bulkhead fitting provides a secure, leak-free pass-through point, allowing -3 AN lines to transition from one side of a panel to the other with a professional, factory-quality finish.
